Structural Survey Summary: 18 Orchard Row

Dear Mr Whitcombe, Thank you for instructing us to inspect the above property on 28 April 2026. This letter summarises our main findings. The full report is enclosed and should be read alongside this summary.

Summary of findings The house is in fair condition for its age, and we found no sign of serious structural movement. The table lists each element that needs attention, with our suggested action and its priority.

ElementConditionActionPriorityRoof coveringFair; some slipped tilesRepair within 12 monthsMediumChimney stackCracked pointingRepoint before autumnHighTimber windowsRot to two sillsReplace the sillsMediumDrainageGully partly blockedClear and testLowElectricsInstallation not testedObtain an inspectionHighDampNo rising damp foundNone requiredNoneGuttersLeaking at two jointsRe-seal the jointsLow
Recommendations
1. Arrange for the chimney stack to be repointed before the autumn.
2. Obtain quotations for the following:
(a) replacement of the two window sills;
(b) re-sealing of the gutter joints.
3. Commission an electrical inspection before exchange of contracts.
